description: Recall of the expense process text. Each case asks a question an employee would ask and names the sentence an answer needs; the snippets come from data/expense_process.txt, so this only passes once that document has been ingested.

cases.query: When is finance approval required for an expense?
Who receives an expense claim after it is submitted?
must_retrieve: finance team receives the expense claim

cases.query: Do I have to attach a receipt to my expense claim?
Is the department budget checked before reimbursement?
What happens to an expense once it has been approved?
How is the employee told about the final decision?
must_retrieve: email notification about the final decision

cases.query: What are the approval thresholds for expenses?
cases.note: Both thresholds have to come back together, or an answer about a large expense will name only one approver.
